name: python-project-inspection
when_to_use: When inspecting, analyzing, testing, or exploring a Python codebase.
steps: Read pyproject.toml to understand declared dependencies, build tools, and CLI entry points.
Execute baseline test suites via 'uv run pytest' before proposing or implementing changes.
Use search tools (search_files) to locate symbols, class definitions, and references instead of guessing.
verification: uv run pytest passes without regressions
